text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hello. I'm Aston Machan, and this is Aston Machan at the Paddock.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm seeing sunny blue skies with
lazy
clouds and calm seas.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a good day. I'm going
to give
this race my all, so keep your
eyes on Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The paddock springs to life with her
arrival.
Meanwhile, there's one more
topic that has the
crowd abuzz.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet in
the Tulip
Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You bet I did! I was right in front of the finish line and it was uh-may-zing!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet are neck and
neck!
Which one will pull ahead?!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAAH!
YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's in! Vodka's across the finish line
in first!
Daiwa Scarlet takes second!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Tough luck, Scarlet! I'm number one today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...
It's fine. I'll get you next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That was just a warm-up! And I still
learned
something from running today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you down when it really
counts—at the
Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You should've seen them! I just had to find out more after that. And guess what! It turns out they're in the same class and they're roommates!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and C
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
They're both, like, a level above their
classmates,
so they've stood out since
day one.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
They're both in it to win it. Apparently
their rivalry started because they both
insisted they
were going to be the best
in their year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Since then, they've just kept vying for
superiority, drawing out each other's full
potential all the
while... or at least that's
what I heard!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No kidding... Sounds like they're perfect
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Oh man! I've got a feeling the Oka Sho is
gonna
be epic!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let the fireworks begin.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Achoo! Sniffle...
